sql: WITH all_actions AS (SELECT t.transaction_key, t.fiscal_year, t.award_key, a.piid, a.recipient_name, t.action_type, t.federal_action_obligation FROM transactions AS t JOIN awards AS a USING (award_key) WHERE t.fiscal_year = 2025) SELECT transaction_key, fiscal_year, award_key, piid, recipient_name, action_type, federal_action_obligation AS obligation_amount FROM all_actions ORDER BY obligation_amount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
